brief: Asserts that value is dataType dayTimeDuration
description: Returns value unchanged if it is dataType dayTimeDuration. Otherwise, including when value is undefined, throws an error. It never converts: to get a dayTimeDuration from a value of another data type, write a typed literal or call a to_ function. This is usually written value as dayTimeDuration.

errorsThrown.reason: value is not the asserted data type
